name: Staff of the Daimyo
body:
Price 43,335 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 8; Weight 6 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This thick oak staff is inlaid with gold and silver spiraling in alternating patterns and is tipped with a large, curved blade. This staff functions as a +2 keen naginata and also allows the use of the following spells.

greater magic weapon (1 charge)
magic vestment (1 charge)
heroism (1 charge)
towering presence* (1 charge)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,125 gp; Feats Craft Staff; Spells greater magic weapon, magic vestment, heroism, towering presence
